globularClusterSandbox.title: Globular Cluster Sandbox
globularClusterSandbox.description: 1,650 stars in a globular cluster evolving under gravitational relaxation and mass segregation, with colour, luminosity, radius and lifetime from MESA-based stellar-evolution relations (Eker et al. 2018), beside the LISA strain and standard-siren localization for dynamically formed binary black holes.
globularClusterSandbox.researchPremise: Binary black holes formed dynamically inside a globular cluster are ejected into the halo, far from the local Galactic potential that perturbs every other timing clock. They therefore survive as unperturbed standard sirens for LISA; paired with an electromagnetic counterpart, each becomes a multi-messenger probe of dark matter.

narrativeArc.to: the person sitting next to you
narrativeArc.summary: Science and its humanities held in one conversation. Chapter 01 is a complex adaptive system read from the outside in; the later chapters turn the same grammar of interaction and feedback on traffic, auctions, household tools and teams.

chapters.title: The Story of a Million Stars: a Complex Adaptive System
chapters.summary: Simulating 662,772 globular clusters and 17.88 million binary black holes at UT Arlington, watching a million stars rearrange themselves, and finding that the same feedback rules traffic, auctions and teams.

persona.name: Domi Jin
persona.headline: Scientist. Builder. Founder.
persona.tagline: A sci-fi mind. An engineer’s hands.

education.dissertationTitle: Prospective Detection of Binary Black Holes in the Local Universe with Gravitational Waves

persona.mission: I work on machine learning and decision systems. My background is in computational astrophysics; my current interests are learning, human judgement and how people work together.
persona.centralQuestion: What helps people make better decisions, learn well and work together?

background.summary: I began in computational astrophysics, studying stellar dynamics and binary black holes through numerical simulation and statistical modelling.
background.evidence: Numerical simulations of globular clusters using N-body and Monte Carlo methods (3,240 MOCCA simulations across 662,772 globular clusters in 8,946 galaxies within 30 Mpc). Analysis of binary black hole evolution (17,883,760 inspiralling BBHs and 86,939 mergers) and gravitational-wave detection prospects for LISA, deriving a lower-bound merger event rate of η ≃ 587 Gpc^-3 yr^-1 and identifying 17 standard sirens localized within ΔV ≤ 1 Mpc^3. LSST Data Science Fellowship: statistical modelling, image processing and reproducible research workflows.

background.summary: I then worked on machine learning for consumer products, marketplaces and advertising, where a model has to be useful within the constraints of a working system.
background.evidence: Recommendation systems using behavioural and contextual signals from mobility data. Marketplace pricing, generative AI request workflows and information exchange between users. Advertising analytics, model evaluation and causal attribution; published architecture notes on real-time bidding and multi-agent control.

background.summary: Building a company brought me closer to the people using the technology. It made me more attentive to what they need, and to the gap between a promising idea and something useful.
background.evidence: Kin Domi, Inc.: AI and community projects concerned with older adults’ independence and access to technology. Open Learning Lab and baby-AI: open research into learning, and specifications for a household agent that runs on local hardware. Essays on learning, team coordination and human–AI collaboration in Domi’s Mind Waves and elsewhere.

philosophy.coreBelief: Good work depends on more than individual ability. Shared context, trust, complementary skills and sensible incentives matter, as does room for people to exercise their own judgement.
philosophy.valueMeasure: I judge technology by what it helps people do: understand a problem, make a choice, learn a skill or spend their time better. Technical elegance is valuable when it serves that purpose.
philosophy.methodology: I try to make assumptions explicit, build something that can be tested and pay attention to the result. Revising an explanation is part of the work.
philosophy.epistemicNote: These are ongoing questions. The linked work distinguishes observations, proposals and research findings.

correspondence.summary: If you are working on a related question, I would be glad to compare notes.
correspondence.detail: Questions, useful references and considered disagreements are welcome.

intellectualInterests.title: Collective Intelligence
intellectualInterests.question: How do individual capabilities combine to produce collective outcomes?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: I am interested in how shared knowledge, communication and trust help groups make use of what their members know.

intellectualInterests.title: Human–AI Collaboration
intellectualInterests.question: How can intelligent systems support human judgement and agency?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: Current projects explore personal memory, voice and messaging interfaces, and local processing, with attention to privacy and human judgement.

intellectualInterests.title: Organisational Intelligence
intellectualInterests.question: How do communication, coordination, trust, and incentives shape collaboration?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: My writing considers shared values, complementary skills, incentives and the practical costs of coordination.

intellectualInterests.title: Complex Adaptive Systems
intellectualInterests.question: How do interactions among individuals give rise to emergent social and organisational behaviour?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: Stellar dynamics, traffic and marketplaces raise related questions about interactions and feedback. I use these comparisons as starting points, with care about where the analogy stops.

intellectualInterests.title: Decision Intelligence
intellectualInterests.question: How can information, feedback, and experimentation improve decisions?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: Work on causal inference, experimentation and decision systems has made me interested in what we measure, and whether it reflects the outcome we care about.

intellectualInterests.title: Human Potential
intellectualInterests.question: How can technology make learning, opportunity, and meaningful participation more accessible?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: Open Learning Lab asks whether learning with AI leads to understanding that lasts and can be used independently. Other writing considers play and learning throughout life.

intellectualInterests.title: AI and Society
intellectualInterests.question: How might increasingly capable intelligence change the ways we work, cooperate, and live?
intellectualInterests.synthesis: Essays consider accessibility, autonomy and the incentives behind AI systems, including observations from work with older adults.

writings.title: Open Learning Lab: Evidence-Driven Personalized Learning Policies
writings.summary: An open research ledger testing which LLM-mediated learning policies produce durable, transferable capability per unit of learner effort outside the tutoring session.
writings.keyInsight: The study asks whether making a design judgement before seeing an expert solution improves later recall and transfer compared with explanation-first tutoring.

writings.title: baby-AI: Receipt-Verified Edge Household Agent Architecture
writings.summary: Five subsystem specifications for perception, speech, memory, adaptation and evaluation, with a hardware cost target below $200.
writings.keyInsight: The design uses signed evaluation records to make claims about on-device learning and privacy inspectable.

writings.title: Life Hack: iMessage as a Low-Bandwidth Router to the Internet
writings.summary: An experiment in using messaging to reach internet-connected agents over limited connections, including in-flight Wi-Fi and satellite text.
writings.keyInsight: Messaging offers a familiar, asynchronous interface for asking an agent to do something without keeping a browser session open.

writings.title: Reclaiming Play as a Life Skill
writings.summary: Examines Jane McGonigal's game mechanics (goals, rules, feedback systems, voluntary participation) through conversations with senior learners and retirees.
writings.keyInsight: The essay considers what clear goals, feedback and voluntary participation can contribute to learning throughout life.

writings.title: Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them
writings.summary: Observations from work with older adults at Kin Domi, alongside six proposals for more accessible driving-assistance interfaces.
writings.keyInsight: The article proposes changes to alert timing, pre-drive checks and voice controls, based on difficulties observed with older users.

writings.title: Overachiever’s Responsibility: Leadership, Alignment, and Sustainable Growth
writings.summary: A reflection on team alignment, complementary skills and sustainable working habits.
writings.keyInsight: The essay uses greatest common divisors and least common multiples as metaphors for shared values and complementary skills, and considers the role of incentives.

writings.title: A Colorful Year Ahead: Milestones & Momentum from Intentional Rhythm
writings.summary: Notes on the eighth revision of a working model built around shared calendars, asynchronous collaboration and weekly reflection.
writings.keyInsight: The working model explores whether shared calendars and asynchronous contributions can make coordination easier.

writings.title: Trace of AppLovin’s 7x Annual Hypergrowth (repository edition)
writings.summary: The living repository edition of the AppLovin essay: the four growth drivers, the four areas where the paradigm is shifting, the growth trap, and the author’s own account of where the work came from.
writings.keyInsight: Growth that depends on scaling data collection carries an economic, ethical and social cost that the scaling law alone does not price in.

writings.title: Serendipity: Where It Sparks & Dedication: Where It Is Channeled
writings.summary: A personal reflection on connections between astrophysics, Confucian ethics and work across disciplines.
writings.keyInsight: The essay considers how ideas from physics, machine learning and human–computer interaction can inform one another.

writings.title: Starting a New Venture & Momentum in Human-Centered Elder AI
writings.summary: Notes on customer research, community outreach and forming the team behind Kin Domi, Inc.
writings.keyInsight: Conversations about difficulties with technology often led to broader questions about independence, dignity and relationships.

writings.title: Reflections from a Coach-Seeking Impulse
writings.summary: Examines the mechanics of coaching, intellectual honesty, and why shared context determines the effectiveness of feedback.
writings.keyInsight: The reflection considers how honesty and shared context affect the usefulness of coaching.

writings.title: Building Proactive Personal AI Memory (Third Ear / TwinMind AMA)
writings.summary: An architectural discussion of personal AI memory, local voice processing, privacy in query rewriting and browser context.
writings.keyInsight: The discussion explores how local processing and selective use of cloud services might balance personal context, privacy and cost.

writings.title: Is Dark Mode Doing More Harm Than Good? A Deeper Look at Our Choices
writings.summary: Uses the visual ergonomics of dark mode as a case study to critique short-term agile feature shipping versus long-term user welfare.
writings.keyInsight: The essay asks how product teams can account for longer-term effects alongside the immediate feedback from feature releases.

writings.title: Trace of AppLovin’s 7x Annual Hypergrowth & The Growth Trap
writings.summary: An analysis of behavioural data, scaling and latency constraints in advertising, with questions about the costs of continued growth.
writings.keyInsight: The analysis asks where additional behavioural data stops adding useful value, and who bears the costs of the resulting systems.

writings.title: Rethinking Digital Advertising: Demand Mining & Dynamic Personalization
writings.summary: Proposes richer intent models, compact user profiles and interfaces that let users request different advertisements.
writings.keyInsight: Letting users request different advertisements is proposed as a way to collect more deliberate preference feedback.

writings.title: From Traffic Lights to Life’s Direction: Crowdsourced Inference & Symbolic AI
writings.summary: Explores how traffic-light timing might be inferred from crowdsourced trajectories, alongside reflections from Wolfram Summer School.
writings.keyInsight: The piece considers what can be inferred from movement data, and where symbolic computation might complement language models.

writings.title: Why Is Some Professional Handwriting Illegible? Information Bandwidth & HCI
writings.summary: An exploration of documentation bottlenecks, the bandwidth of speech and writing, and institutional information barriers.
writings.keyInsight: The essay asks whether voice interfaces could reduce the effort of recording information at its source.

writings.title: All About ChatGPT: Flat Correlation, Unit Economics & Alignment
writings.summary: A 2023 essay on language models, search economics, symbolic computation and the limitations of feedback used for alignment.
writings.keyInsight: The essay asks how statistical prediction relates to reasoning, and who should participate in decisions about model behaviour.

writings.title: Free Market in a Possibility Universe & The Collaborative Manifesto
writings.summary: Explores information asymmetry, resource coordination and proposals for liquid democracy.
writings.keyInsight: The proposal considers how individual ownership and collective decision-making might be reconciled.

writings.title: Gravitational Waves from Binary Black Holes in Globular Clusters & Open Research
writings.summary: Doctoral work on globular clusters and binary black holes, alongside notes on reproducible computational research.
writings.keyInsight: Numerical simulation, statistical analysis and reproducible workflows provided the methodological basis for my later work.
